hooks.command: echo '{"systemMessage": "If you added or changed a pipeline output, visualization, or data file this session — update its row in docs/outputs.md before committing."}'

out=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && MPLCONFIGDIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/mpl" .venv/bin/python check_charts.py --quiet 2>/dev/null) || jq -n --arg report "$out" '{systemMessage: ("Chart check failed — committed charts are missing, orphaned, or stale:\n" + $report)}'; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in .env|*/.env|.env.*|*/.env.*|uv.lock|*/uv.lock) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Protected file: .env holds API keys and uv.lock changes only via uv lock / uv add."}}' ;; seeds/*.csv|*/seeds/*.csv|seeds/*.xls*|*/seeds/*.xls*) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"seeds/ data changes only via a gated promote or a deliberate cp from data/output/ — confirm this is a hand-derived reference file."}}' ;; esac; exit 0

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(] *)(make +classify\b|(uv +run +)?(python3? +)?(\./)?classify_tasks\.py\b)'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Task classification is ~19k paid Vertex AI calls. Ask the user to run it themselves (! make classify)."}}'; fi; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) r="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/ruff"; [ -x "$r" ] || r="uv run --quiet ruff"; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && $r format --quiet "$f" && $r check --fix --unfixable F401 --quiet "$f" >&2 || exit 2 ;; esac; exit 0
